t: Self-adhesive flashing tape that bonds instantly to a wide range of building materials, providing a permanent, watertight seal in all climates. Ideal for both preventing and repairing problems related to damp and water ingress, making it a reliable choice for both new build and maintenance projects. The flexible bitumen flashing tape is compatible with brick, masonry, slate, concrete roof tiles, wood, metal, concrete, terracotta tiles, glass, roofing felt and rigid plastics. Supplied on a 10m roll, and can be applied with hand pressure and a seam roller, eliminating the need for special tools to cut, form or fix. The durable tape is tear and impact-resistant due to its four-layer construction and can withstand extreme temperatures from -10 to 100°C. This waterproof flashing tape is particularly effective in repairing lead flashing, sealing valley gutters, mending leaks in drain pipes and guttering, greenhouse repairs, protecting glazing bars, insulating pipes and tanks, and repairing roofing felt joints on flat roofs.
